# 🔀 Pull Request Template

Thank you for contributing to the **C Programming Repository**!  
Please use this template to ensure your pull request is clear and helpful.

---

## 📌 Description
Provide a summary of the changes you are making.  
- What program(s) or files did you add/update?  
- Why are these changes useful?  

---

## 🐞 Related Issue
If this PR fixes an issue, link it here:  
`Fixes #issue_number`

---

## 🚀 Type of Change
Select the type(s) of change your PR introduces:
- [ ] New Program (new `.c` file)  
- [ ] Bug Fix  
- [ ] Documentation Update (README, CONTRIBUTING, etc.)  
- [ ] Enhancement (improvement of existing code)  
- [ ] Other  

---

## ✅ Checklist
Before submitting, please confirm:
- [ ] My code compiles without errors.  
- [ ] I have added comments to explain logic.  
- [ ] I have updated the **Program Index** in `README.md` if applicable.  
- [ ] I have tested the program/output successfully.  
- [ ] I have followed the repository’s coding style.  

---

## 📷 Screenshots (if applicable)
Attach screenshots or terminal outputs to show your program working.

---

## 🙏 Additional Notes
Add any extra context or suggestions here.
